checkedAlternates.risk: Augmented Fourth is a fourth like Perfect Fourth.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Spanning 6 semitones, the Augmented Fourth is the tritone (group-1), distinct from the 5-semitone Perfect Fourth (group-4).
Sixths are major or minor (group-3), never perfect in standard Western theory.
